idea-plugin.name: Handoff for Claude Code
idea-plugin.description:
Handoff is the place where Claude Code hands work over to you, and you hand the result back.

Some steps an AI agent should not run on its own: deploys, logins, releases, uploads. Instead of copying a command out of the chat, running it somewhere and pasting the output back, Claude proposes it through the IDE's MCP server. It shows up in the Handoff tool window with the reason and the working directory. Run it, edit it first or dismiss it; exit code and output go straight back to Claude.

Features

  • Proposed commands with reason and working directory, risky ones (deploy, push, publish, delete) highlighted.
  • One click to run, output in the Run tool window. Edit the command before running, or dismiss it with a note for Claude.
  • Result back to Claude: exit code and the last lines of output, no copy and paste.
  • One changelist per task: files Claude changes for a task land in their own changelist "Claude: <task>", ready to review and commit on their own.
  • Review with line notes: Claude asks you to review its changes; open the diff, attach notes to single lines (hover a line, click the +) and approve or send the notes back, each with path, line and code.
  • Command sequences: several commands as one card, run all or step by step, stops at the first failure.
  • Claude is waiting (optional): a card and a notification when a Claude Code session in the project is done or needs your input.
  • Notifications when something is waiting while the IDE is in the background.
  • Images to review or choose from: one image to approve, or several variants to pick one. A viewer with zoom and paging lets you mark areas with a frame and a note for Claude, right on the image.
  • Memory: everything Claude Code loads into each session (CLAUDE.md files, imports, project memory) as a tree with token estimates per file and section, warnings for memories missing from the index, on-demand files and duplicated paragraphs.
  • Usage: tokens per day and session for the project, and optionally your 5-hour and weekly plan limits.
  • Nothing runs without your click.

Setup

  • Enable the IDE's MCP server (Settings | Tools | MCP Server) and connect Claude Code to it.
  • Claude Code then sees the tools handoff_propose_command, handoff_propose_sequence, handoff_wait_for_result, handoff_show_images, handoff_request_review, handoff_get_notes, handoff_begin_task and handoff_end_task.
  • Tell Claude when to use them: the empty Commands tab copies a ready-made snippet for your CLAUDE.md.
  • The built-in guide (? in the tool window header) lists the setup and a prompt per feature.

Works with Claude Code and other MCP clients. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

You can support it via GitHub Sponsors or buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.
